explanation: Queen and mother of King Ahaziah of Judah, who seized power after her son's death and attempted to wipe out the line of David.
Son of Ahaziah, rescued from Athaliah's massacre and later crowned king of Judah at the age of seven.
Half-sister of Ahaziah and aunt of Joash, who saved him from Athaliah's massacre and hid him in the temple.
High priest in the temple and husband of Jehosheba, who led the revolt against Athaliah and helped Joash become king.
An agreement or commitment between two parties, in this case between God and the people of Judah, promising loyalty and obedience.
Soldiers who protected the temple and the king, playing a key role in overthrowing Athaliah and installing Joash as king.
